_comment: Behaviour settings for brain-ingest-slack. timezone: IANA name used to file messages under their local posting date (null = owner.timezone from brainos.json). workspace_url builds permalinks from channel_id + ts (the Slack MCP returns none). flag_reaction: the emoji NAME you react with to flag a message for ingest (no colons). owner_slack_user_id: your own Slack user ID, used by ingest-owed-replies.
